title: Grateful Dead Live at Red Rocks Amphitheatre on 1982-07-28
lineage: FOB - Senn 421's> Sony TC-D5 (at mouth of the stage)> Nak Dragon Playback> HHB CDR-850 (no DAT gen)> CDR

ai_review.summary: High‑energy Red Rocks show with smoking Let It Grow and a crisp front‑of‑house audience tape
ai_review.review: The July 28, 1982 performance at Red Rocks is celebrated for its relentless rain‑soaked intensity – Shakedown, Lazy/Supplication/Deal, a monster Let It Grow and a thrilling Not Fade Away with an unforgettable St. Stephen tease.  The front‑of‑house audience recording (FOB) is praised as lively and clear despite occasional level‑adjustment chatter, making the music highly listenable.

ai_rating.rationale: The vast majority of reviews are 5‑star, highlighting both an exceptional performance and a good‑quality audience recording; only minor complaints about level tweaks appear.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Front‑of‑house (FOB) tape noted as lively, rich and mostly clear; occasional comments about tapers stepping on cables or raising levels but no distortion reported.

show_quality.setlist_flow: First set powers through the rain with a tight, high‑octane run; second set builds on that momentum with spacey jams, a rare Let It Grow in the second set and an ecstatic Not Fade Away finale.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Repeatedly praised for scorching solos, especially his Let It Grow solo; described as 'the man' with intense tone and humor.
band_member_comments.Phil: Mentioned smiling and being ready to go; occasional “Phil bombs” vibe noted but no detailed critique.
band_member_comments.Bob: Vocal slip on Truckin' lyric highlighted; otherwise praised for strong vocals on NFA and overall presence.
band_member_comments.Keys: Brent's piano/jangly sound singled out as a highlight of the show.
band_member_comments.Drums: Drum jam after first set noted as excellent; overall tight rhythm section.
